{{Quote|We wanted to do ''The First Jedi.'' Basically how the Jedi Order came to be, why it came to be, the first lightsaber…|David Benioff|<ref name="THR" />}}
'''''The First Jedi''''' was the first ''[[Star Wars]]'' film of a [[Untitled Star Wars film series|planned series of films]] to be helmed by [[David Benioff]] and [[D.B. Weiss]], which was first announced by [[Lucasfilm]] on [[February 6]], [[2018]].<ref name="swcom">{{SW|url=news/game-of-thrones-creators-david-benioff-and-d-b-weiss-to-write-and-produce-a-new-series-of-star-wars-films|text=''Game of Thrones'' Creators David Benioff and D.B. Weiss to Write and Produce a New Series of ''Star Wars'' Films|nolive=1}}</ref> However, on [[October 28]], [[2019]], it was reported that Benioff and Weiss had exited the film series due to scheduling conflicts.<ref name="canceled">{{WebCite|url=https://deadline.com/2019/10/star-wars-setback-game-of-thrones-duo-david-benioff-d-b-weiss-exit-trilogy-1202771184|text='Star Wars' Setback: 'Game Of Thrones' Duo David Benioff & D.B. Weiss Exit Trilogy|author=Geoff Boucher|date=2019-10-28|work=[[Wikipedia:Deadline Hollywood|''Deadline'']]|archivedate=20200721195000}}</ref><ref name="THR report">{{WebCite|url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/heat-vision/why-star-wars-didnt-work-game-thrones-duo-1250798|text=Divided Attention and Toxic Fandom: Why the 'Game of Thrones' Duo Bailed on 'Star Wars'|author=Lesley Goldber|date=2019-10-30|work=[[Wikipedia:The Hollywood Reporter|''The Hollywood Reporter'']]|archivedate=20200523084713}}</ref> On [[October 30]], [[Wikipedia:Variety (magazine)|''Variety'']] reported that the plans Benioff and Weiss had for the film series involved the exploration of the origins of the [[Jedi]]. On [[January 10]], [[2024]], the duo confirmed that their project was focused on exploring how the [[Jedi Order]] began, why it began, and exploring the first [[lightsaber]] and they confirmed that Lucasfilm ultimately passed on the project and were not interested. During the interview they also revealed the film's original title ''The First Jedi'', and that they abandoned the title when their longtime friend [[Rian Johnson]] titled his film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''The Last Jedi'']].<ref name="THR" />

Despite the cancellation of the project by Benioff and Weiss, a new [[Untitled Star Wars film (James Mangold)|''Star Wars'' film]] that is set to explore the [[dawn of the Jedi era]] was announced on April 7, 2023 to be directed by [[James Mangold]].<ref name="New movies">{{SW|url=news/swce-2023-new-star-wars-films|text=SWCE 2023: Three New ''Star Wars'' Movies Announced|date=2023-04-07}}</ref>
